rationale: Defines the structured output contract for the entire pipeline

requirement: aero_filewrite raises ValueError (message contains empty) for an empty result list
rationale: An empty list is always a caller error; silent NaN-filled tables are harder to diagnose
Provenance field lets users identify when a table was generated

requirement: Reference quantities (Sref, Cref, Bref, Xref, Yref, Zref) are read from the first result
rationale: Carries reference geometry from the .st file through to the aero database without a separate geometry argument

requirement: A StabTable is created for every name in COEF_NAMES
rationale: All standard 6-DOF coefficients must be queryable even if some were absent from some runs

requirement: A CtrlTable is created for every (coef, surface) pair keyed as <coef>_<d_idx>_<ctrl_name>
rationale: Each control surface independently affects every coefficient; the compound key prevents collisions

requirement: Alpha breakpoints are sorted in ascending order
rationale: Monotonic axes are required by scipy RegularGridInterpolator and MATLAB lookup-table blocks

requirement: Beta breakpoints are sorted in ascending order
rationale: Monotonic axes are required by scipy RegularGridInterpolator and MATLAB lookup-table blocks
Correct shape is required for 2-D table indexing and interpolation

requirement: Neutral-control results (all deflections ≈ 0) populate StabTable at the correct (alpha, beta) cell
rationale: Off-neutral data must not enter the neutral aero map; populating only on zero-deflection runs enforces this

requirement: Off-neutral results do not overwrite StabTable cells
rationale: Ensures the neutral map is uncontaminated even when neutral and deflected runs share the same breakpoint

requirement: CtrlTable.data shape is (n_alpha x n_beta x n_defl)
rationale: Correct shape is required for 3-D lookup table blocks and RegularGridInterpolator

requirement: CtrlTable defl breakpoints are sorted in ascending order
rationale: Monotonic defl axis is required for 3-D interpolation routines

requirement: CtrlTable cell values match source StResult.data values
rationale: Ensures no silent truncation or reordering during pivot from list to 3-D array

requirement: CtrlTable.surface is <d_idx>_<ctrl_name> and CtrlTable.ctrl_name is the surface name
rationale: Metadata fields are used for axis labels and export struct field names

requirement: Geometry with no control surfaces produces an empty ctrl dict
rationale: ctrl must not contain phantom entries for non-existent surfaces

requirement: Geometry with no control surfaces still fills StabTable
rationale: Stability-only models are valid and must produce a complete neutral aero map

requirement: A coefficient absent from a result's .data produces NaN at that table cell
rationale: NaN distinguishes a genuinely missing value from a coefficient that happens to be zero
